summary: OICA's 2025 vehicle production: China builds over three times the US, but the rest are the car countries players expect, so a casual player gets most of them.
reasons: Builder's own replays, pending a real judge (the builder knew the answers when writing them). Two casual orders found 10; the UK (#19), Italy (#26), Canada (#14) and Sweden (#31) are the misses.
Close at the bottom: France 1,463,991 (#10), Thailand 1,455,569 (#11). Countries without a 2025 figure show their 2024 or 2020 one.
Likely too easy for Today's list; car-makers and car-models are already in the bank.
fixes: If a judge agrees on free play, drop its `debut` flag in topics.ts, or it waits out of random play for good.
